items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: H. L. Mencken in the American Mercury came up and discovered Hemingway.

ctx.x: And, incidentally, Dave Tough was one of the first people I ever heard speak about Hemingway. He idolized Hemingway and I remember that six months after
Dave Tough told me about Hemingway, The Sun Also Rises, H. L. Mencken in the American Mercury came up and discovered Hemingway.
